Compare observed and predicted EEG time courses across sensors

Source: R/plot_sensor_trajectories.R
plot_sensor_trajectories.Rd

Plots observed sensor-wise means (black) against posterior median model predictions (blue), optionally with credible ribbons. Trajectories can be placed in approximate scalp positions, sharing one amplitude scale, or displayed as ordinary facets. Detected clusters can appear as translucent rectangles or as thicker, opaque portions of the *predicted* trajectories. Cluster segments respect sign, cluster ID and gaps in the time grid.

Usage

plot_sensor_trajectories(
  results,
  observed_data,
  observed_data_b = NULL,
  outcome_id = "voltage",
  sensor_id = "channel",
  time_id = "time",
  spatial_id = c("xproj", "yproj"),
  participant_id = NULL,
  layout = c("scalp", "facets"),
  cluster_style = c("rectangles", "segments", "none"),
  cluster_alpha = 0.18,
  highlighted_linewidth = 1.1,
  max_gap = NULL,
  show_ci = TRUE,
  ncol = 8L,
  free_y = FALSE,
  sensors = NULL,
  sensor_order = NULL,
  mini_width = NULL,
  mini_height = NULL,
  amplitude_limits = NULL,
  show_labels = TRUE,
  head_outline = TRUE
)

Arguments

results

Output from [analyse_bgam_spatiotemporal()].

observed_data

Original long-form observations, or condition A.

observed_data_b

Observed condition B for A - B contrasts.

outcome_id

Observed outcome column.

sensor_id

Sensor identifier column.

time_id

Numeric time column.

spatial_id

Two projected sensor coordinates.

participant_id

Optional participant ID for an equal-participant- weighted observed average. With `NULL`, observations are pooled.

layout

`"scalp"` for mini-trajectories at electrode positions or `"facets"` for one independent panel per sensor.

cluster_style

`"rectangles"` for transparent backgrounds, `"segments"` for highlighted prediction lines, or `"none"`.

cluster_alpha

Opacity of cluster rectangle backgrounds.

highlighted_linewidth

Width of cluster-highlighted segments.

max_gap

Maximum time gap for joining cluster members. Defaults to 1.5 times the median sampling interval.

show_ci

Plot posterior credible interval ribbons.

ncol

Number of facet columns when `layout = "facets"`.

free_y

Use independent amplitude limits in faceted plots.

sensors

Optional vector of sensors to display.

sensor_order

Optional vector specifying the order of facet panels.

mini_width

Width of each scalp mini-trace in projected units; defaults to 80 percent of median nearest-sensor spacing.

mini_height

Height of each scalp mini-trace in projected units; defaults to 75 percent of median nearest-sensor spacing.

amplitude_limits

Optional common amplitude range for scalp traces.

show_labels

Display sensor labels in scalp layout.

head_outline

Add a schematic head circle and nose in scalp layout.

Value

A ggplot object.

Author

Ladislas Nalborczyk ladislas.nalborczyk@cnrs.fr.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_sensor_trajectories(
    results_st, eeg_data2, outcome_id = "voltage",
    sensor_id = "channel", layout = "scalp",
    cluster_style = "segments"
)
} # }
